We need to create a static website for "快送外卖" (fast delivery). The site should have at least index.html and two other pages: category list page, restaurant page with dishes and prices, order confirmation page. Provide real content, with categories, restaurants, menu items, prices. Provide navigation. Use CSS and JavaScript in files. Use relative links. No remote resources. Should be mobile-friendly for 1440 width and responsive for narrower. No references to AI. No target="_blank". Keep same tab.

We should create: index.html (home with categories, maybe a search bar). categories.html or maybe categories.html (list of restaurants per category). restaurant.html (show menu). order.html (confirmation page). Could also have about.html or contact. But at least 4 pages. They request at least two pages besides index.

We should design minimal but professional. We'll provide basic CSS and JS for interactive ordering (like adding items to cart). But no form submission.

Let's plan structure:

index.html: hero section, categories list (e.g., 快餐, 中餐, 日料, 甜品). Each category link to categories.html? Or each to its own page. We could use categories.html with query param: categories.html?type=快餐. Simpler: create categories.html that lists categories with links to category pages. Then restaurants.html that lists restaurants in a category. Then restaurant.html that lists menu and allows selecting items, add to order, then navigate to order.html.

Simplify: Use two pages besides index: restaurants.html (restaurant list for selected category) and restaurant.html (restaurant details). Add order.html. That makes 4 pages. Provide navigation.

But they said at least two pages besides index, so we can have 4 pages total. Let's provide: index.html, restaurants.html, restaurant.html, order.html.

We must include CSS and JS in each file. We could have shared CSS/JS but we can't reference remote, so maybe put in each file inline. Or create separate CSS file but spec says "把 CSS 和 JavaScript 写在文件里。不要加载远程样式表、字体或脚本。", so we can have separate CSS/JS files. But the instruction says: "不要在网站中提及这些说明。请严格按照以下格式以多个文件的形式返回网站，不要添加任何其他说明" Means we must output multiple files: index.html, restaurants.html, restaurant.html, order.html, maybe style.css, script.js. But we must not include any other text outside the file markers.

We can provide CSS in each file inline in <style> and JS in <script> tags inside each file. That avoids separate files.

Simplify: Put <style> inside each file. Put <script> inside each file. That is easiest.

But we need to keep consistency: navigation links to other pages. We'll include a simple navbar with "快送外卖" brand linking to index.

We need a simple cart logic: On restaurant page, user can select quantity for each dish and click "加入订单". The order confirmation page will display selected items and total. Since we can't persist across pages without backend, we could use localStorage to store order data.

Implement: On restaurant page, when clicking add, store selected items in localStorage under key 'orderItems'. Then order.html reads from localStorage to display.

But spec: "不要提交或发送任何内容" means no form submission to server. That's okay.

order.html: read localStorage, display order items, total price. Provide "返回首页" and "继续订餐".
